references.text: Confirms the identity and lineage of Nahshon as tribal chief in Judah, linking him to David's line.
Provides the complete genealogical context and confirms Nahshon's role as tribal chief, enriching the understanding of his place in David's family tree.
Shows how the historical genealogy from Ruth becomes a fundamental part of Jesus' Messianic lineage in the New Testament.
Completes the genealogical line by linking Salmon directly to Boaz, thereby confirming Ruth's role in David's family.
